# Tano Core 0.9.0

Prepared on 2026-10-28. Publication remains pending local acceptance.

- Add an offline Excalidraw plugin with ordinary Markdown storage, compressed
  Obsidian scene import, automatic saving, conflict recovery and drawing/PNG export.
- Add safe, read-only Office attachment previews and continuous PDF, Word and
  PowerPoint readers with lazy pages, thumbnails, zoom and header controls.
- Unify preview loading, scrollbars and plugin surfaces, preserving independent
  pane controls and document identity.
- Distribute the complete Core set as five npm packages and one Rust crate at
  the same version and source commit. Preserve all bundled third-party notices.

No workspace migration is required. This Core release does not publish desktop
installers or certify Android, Apple or other untested native platforms.
Exact local validation commands, results and tested source identity are retained
in private release evidence.
